item.title: Version 1.30.2
item.description:
New

  • Webcam layout switching in the editor — switch between 5 modes: Screen Only, Webcam Only,
Picture-in-Picture, Side by Side, and Speaker Focus (DEBUT-175)
  • Create new blank projects from the dashboard — open an empty editor and add videos, photos, or
start recording (DEBUT-165)
  • Add clips from the timeline — "+" button after the last clip and double-click empty timeline
space to add clips

Improved

  • Suggest trimming when the last click is in the menu bar area for full-screen recordings
(DEBUT-85)
  • Left/right arrow keys for frame-by-frame navigation when a track is selected (DEBUT-103)
  • Link to full changelog on the website in Sparkle appcast (DEBUT-87)
  • Side-by-side layout supports draggable divider and drag-to-swap sides
  • Layout transitions animate smoothly with configurable borders

Fixed

  • Export hang caused by CIImage extent issues, webcam mask alignment, and Z-ordering
  • Clip deletion now properly removes all associated data (zoom segments, clicks, cursor movements,
webcam segments) and cleans up orphaned media assets
  • Editor view no longer shows black screen during normal recording
